svg.title: OpenLakeForge on AWS
svg.desc: The target AWS shape: on Amazon EKS, Dagster launches dlt, Floe and dbt-trino. Data lands in per-stage Amazon S3 buckets; Silver and Gold are Iceberg tables in the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Trino runs Gold SQL and serves Superset. Services keep state in Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. olf applies Terraform and Helm onto EKS, which pulls images from Amazon ECR. Users come in through Route 53, an Application Load Balancer with ACM, oauth2-proxy and Dex with GitHub login.
svg.text: webserver · daemon · code server · one isolated run pod per pipeline run
one shared catalog for every stage,
